acceptanceCriteria: A1: The dynamic light, standard, and strict route remains fail-closed and the Rust gate is the authority for Contract-bound standard/strict CI.
A2: Rust gate reports bind repository identity, Contract/base/snapshot digests, route, policy decision, and current Runtime without writing .ai records.
A3: CI invokes the Rust gate before repository commands for standard and strict routes while retaining Python/Cargo shadow checks and rejecting disagreement.
A4: Negative tests cover malformed, foreign, stale, symlink, policy-conflicting, manifest-tampered, route-tampered, and human-review-required inputs.
A5: Tri-language documentation, parity rows, and inventory records are registered before verification and describe the semantic/non-wire and source-build versus immutable Release boundaries.
A6: The installed Runtime lifecycle, hosted PR checks, finalization, close, exact branch/worktree cleanup, and object/adopter boundary are evidenced.
goal: Make hosted CI consume the same Rust Contract and verification truth while retaining the dynamic light/standard/strict route and Python/Cargo shadow comparison.
intent: Re-deliver the bounded Contract-aware CI quality gate after WI-292 was rejected for archiving before PR merge.
